body.statement: The deleted-diagonal network has maximum value \(W(o,e)=\min\{H,g,\min_{i\in\mathcal J}(H-h_i+g-b_i)\}\). Its realized flow and residual-failure filling return a member of \(\mathcal Q(o,e)\) with \(\theta=g-W(o,e)=L(o,e)\); whenever a left row has positive unused capacity, every adjacent right block is saturated, so its remaining demand can be filled inside the existing failure union.
body.justification: The saturation implication is the nonnegative residual invariant that closes the lower endpoint for every compatible margin vector.
body.gap: Xie--Li solve the binary response system by finite active regions; Koperberg supplies Hall machinery but not this PoC-specific diagonal deletion and residual categorical completion.
body.consumer: The min-cut identity provides a checkable explanation of which factual stratum or total failure capacity determines the sharp lower probability.
